entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnetup`: Make tests localization-safe #55330
  • [NETSDKE2E] [Dotnetup]Re-run dotnetup init failed with error The install path already contains a .NET installation that is not tracked by dotnetup after interrupted init #55315
  • [NETSDKE2E][Dotnetup] 'dotnetup sdk uninstall 8.0' removes unrelated SDK 10.0.204. #55312
  • [NETSDKE2E] [Dotnetup]dotnetup should not uninstall .NET SDK that is currently in use #55311
  • dotnet test opaquely fails with Zero tests ran in MTP mode when --nologo is used #55309
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #55308

Closed

  • `OpenTelemetry` with `Azure Monitor Exporter` seems to not be designed for `CLI` Applications #55184
  • new issueSd #55294
  • Enable NAOT command handling by default #55078
    11.0.1xx
  • `dnx` crashes with on Alpine/musl because direct dotnet.dll invocation lacks HOSTFXR_PATH #55238
  • CA2007 flagged for `await using` duck-typed async disposable. #53461
  • No file properties added to exe (windows) in publish #45994
